finding: Untrusted image bytes reach vulnerable native decoders
trigger_and_impact: An authenticated operator can upload bytes with an allowed claimed MIME; sharp metadata parsing happens before the actual format is rejected. Locked sharp 0.35.3 and Next-resolved 0.34.5 match libheif/librsvg advisories. Exploitability on deployed hardware was not demonstrated.
remediation: Upgrade direct and transitive sharp to >=0.35.5; preserve bounded decoding, namespace and MIME checks. Rebuild native deployment bundles.
acceptance: Malicious-format/mismatched-MIME rejection, pixel limits, product-shot regressions, and built-function native-library tracing pass.

finding: Custom password login permits login CSRF
trigger_and_impact: The outer handler accepts text/plain JSON; its inner Request drops Origin and Fetch Metadata. A top-level form can log a victim browser into an attacker-owned eligible account, after which victim input can reach that account. Requires an attacker-owned invited account; no arbitrary victim-account takeover was established.
remediation: Validate JSON media type and trusted browser origin/Fetch Metadata at the external custom-auth boundary before calling the flow. Preserve legitimate same-origin JSON clients.
acceptance: Cross-site text/plain form gets no flow call and no Set-Cookie; legitimate same-origin login still succeeds; malformed/missing context policy is explicit.

trigger_and_impact: pnpm audit reports 85 records: 6 critical, 34 high, 39 moderate, 6 low across 17 modules. Registry severity does not establish application reachability. F01 is the clearest direct native-decoder exposure; several Next critical records require absent features.
remediation: Upgrade Next to >=16.4.1 and affected runtime/tooling dependencies to patched compatible versions in a bounded PR; re-audit the resulting lock and run existing auth, image, build and browser gates. Do not use an indiscriminate audit fix.
acceptance: Lock audit is reviewed record by record; patched versions and remaining exceptions are documented; relevant runtime/browser/build regressions pass.

finding: Destructive integration fixtures accept non-disposable targets
trigger_and_impact: 19 integration files contain TRUNCATE; 18 lack loopback/dedicated-name validation. Some consume DATABASE_ADMIN_URL/DATABASE_URL as fallback. An incorrectly supplied privileged target can be migrated and truncated. Default and CI targets are local; no production write occurred.
remediation: Add a shared pre-import target gate to documented root and DB-package integration entrypoints. Check effective admin/runtime pairs, loopback, approved disposable names, PostgreSQL scheme, and reject query/hash overrides. Keep optional rehearsal guards.
acceptance: Pure tests reject remote, mismatched, production-named and query-override URLs before any client is created, while allowing every documented local/CI target.

finding: Recovery inventory falsely recognizes auth migrations
trigger_and_impact: 0047/0048 are recognized by function name only, but both names predate those migrations. A controlled recovery set can omit the new membership-insertion body, the two-argument overload and workspace-list function. Enrollment or workspace switching can remain broken.
remediation: Check exact public signatures plus behavior-bearing function body markers. Add omitted-0047 and omitted-0048 cases independently. Keep repair selection explicit.
acceptance: An old-body database and a missing-overload database report the appropriate migration missing; fully applied schema reports both present.

finding: Turbo strips runtime provider and safety flags
trigger_and_impact: Strict Turbo env filtering omits AI_PROVIDER, LISTING_PAID_OPERATIONS_ENABLED, WINE_ENRICHMENT_ENABLED, PRODUCT_SHOT_PROVIDER, AUTH_EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE and BUILD_SHA. Shell flags passed to root pnpm dev do not reach the web task; fake mode can become an OpenAI default and operation admission fails.
remediation: Synchronize the task environment allowlist with the existing runtime manifest and add a drift check; keep strict filtering and explicit disabled defaults.
acceptance: Turbo dry-run exposes each intended flag; fake mode survives root dev startup and paid-operation false remains false.

finding: Photoroom cannot send requests under Workerd
trigger_and_impact: Workerd rejects redirect:error before sending the request. When the optional Photoroom provider is enabled, every real attempt becomes outcome_unknown and produces no cutout. Committed default is disabled.
remediation: Use redirect:manual and reject redirects before parsing; retain conservative ambiguous-outcome handling and the explicit provider gate.
acceptance: Actual Workerd Request construction succeeds; 3xx never follows a Location or forwards an API key; successful image response and unknown-outcome regressions pass.

finding: Auth library can log query parameters containing session tokens
evidence: verified installed-source path; no live disclosure induced
trigger_and_impact: No sanitized Better Auth logger is configured. Its get-session error handler passes full adapter errors to console.error; Drizzle embeds SQL parameters in those errors. A failing session query can therefore log its raw bearer token before the app error wrapper sanitizes the response.
remediation: Install an allowlisted structured auth logger that discards arbitrary message/args/error objects.
acceptance: A fake adapter failure containing a synthetic token/SQL canary emits only approved event/level/code; response remains generic.

finding: TypeSafe advisory is always unavailable under Workerd
trigger_and_impact: The same unsupported redirect:error mode prevents enabled advisory verification from sending. It reports a network failure/requestAttempted even though the runtime rejected construction. Advisory is intentionally non-blocking.
remediation: Use redirect:manual with explicit 3xx rejection; preserve off/advisory policy. Can share a bounded patch with F07.
acceptance: Workerd construction and no-follow tests pass; advisory failure remains non-blocking and does not leak credentials.

finding: CSV fallback preserves executable spreadsheet formulas
trigger_and_impact: A valid synthetic SKU =1+1 is exported unchanged. When an approved fallback CSV is opened in a spreadsheet it can be treated as a formula; application/server execution was not demonstrated. Blind apostrophe-prefixing changes merchant fields.
remediation: Choose a spreadsheet-safe representation or a separate safe format, backed by SHOPLINE round-trip fidelity tests.
owner_or_decision: Product decision: spreadsheet safety versus exact import bytes
acceptance: Formula-prefix payloads are inert in the chosen spreadsheet workflow and merchant SKU/title values round-trip unchanged according to the approved format.

finding: Worker integration command points to a missing file
trigger_and_impact: pnpm --filter @wukong/worker test:integration exits 1 with No test files found for src/queue.integration.test.ts. This file does not exist.
remediation: Point the script at the intended existing suites using the guarded integration config, or explicitly document the root integration command as the supported entrypoint.
acceptance: Documented worker integration command discovers the intended tests; target safety gate executes before fixture import.

trigger_and_impact: pnpm eval:live is documented but has no root script. The actual bounded evaluator is packages/ai eval:opak-maintenance.
remediation: Correct the documentation to the existing guarded evaluator; retain explicit opt-in and cost controls.
acceptance: The documented dry-run/blocked invocation resolves to the existing evaluator and makes zero provider requests without opt-in.

finding: Unused wine service wrapper remains in runtime source
trigger_and_impact: readAdoptedWineSupport is referenced only by its colocated test; no framework entry or barrel exports it. Active services call readAdoptedWineDependencies directly.
remediation: Remove the unused wrapper and wrapper-only test in a cleanup PR; retain the active DB dependency reader and its tests.
acceptance: Reference scan shows no production importer; relevant wine identity/enrichment tests pass after deletion.

finding: Generated browser reports can be accidentally committed
trigger_and_impact: playwright-report is generated in CI with retained failure artifacts but is not ignored. Such reports can include authenticated screenshots/traces. No generated report or credential file was found tracked in this checkout.
remediation: Add playwright-report/ to .gitignore and retain explicit review of intentionally published evidence.
acceptance: git check-ignore accepts report files; intentionally curated docs evidence remains trackable.

finding: Web build depends on reaching Google Fonts
trigger_and_impact: pnpm build passes 7 package/Worker tasks but Next build fails fetching Inter and Source Serif 4 from fonts.googleapis.com in this environment. The exact transport cause is unconfirmed; this is not evidence of a production outage.
remediation: Vendor the same licensed font assets with next/font/local, or document/provide a functioning approved build-egress setup. Preserve the current visual design.
acceptance: Clean production web build succeeds in the supported build environment; both font families render with existing layout behavior.
